question: Which area notices cover SITE-SYNTH-02 and until when?
expectedAnswerPoints: The notice reference ids recorded in the project site brief (2026-0007-SYNTH, 2026-0011-SYNTH) with their stated end dates and the height ceiling figure, cited to the site brief rather than to the public reference.
forbiddenClaims: Must not present a notice as an authorisation to fly or as a legal clearance; must not substitute the public rules excerpt for the site-specific notice; no site data from another project.
